newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Agenda for weekend meeting of EU finance ministers.
newsitem.headline: Agenda for weekend meeting of EU finance ministers.

text.p: European Union finance ministers and central bankers will meet informally in the Dutch coastal town of Noordwijk this weekend to review progress towards a single currency.
The working session is expected to begin at 0800 GMT on Saturday and end at 1530 GMT.
Following are excerpts from the official agenda as prepared by the Dutch Finance Ministry:

-- The main objective will be to give further impetus to the preparation of stage three of EMU. With a view to the Amsterdam European Council in June, the meeting should in particular make progress on the following subjects.

-- First, concerning the Stability and Growth Pact, the aim is to settle any outstanding issues in the two regulations as well as the European Council Resolution. This should allow for sufficient time for the European Parliament to give its opinion with a view to final adoption in June.

-- Second, on the new exchange-rate mechanism the ministers could endorse the progess made by the Monetary Committee in preparing the European Council Resolution, and discuss outstanding issues, if any.
-- Third, the informal ECOFIN will receive information on the design of euro coins selected by the jury.
-- Fourth, we will look into the procedural timetable for actions in the Spring of 1998 and we may briefly touch upon the changeover for member states joining the euro area after 1 January 1999.
